title: Will Robots Take Over?
subtitle: 考点：机器人与工作 / replace / depend on
passage: Robots are already doing jobs in factories, hospitals and shops. Some people worry that robots will take over all jobs. Experts say this is not likely. Robots can do simple, repeated tasks very well, but they cannot replace people everywhere.

Jobs that depend on creativity, such as writing, designing and teaching, will still need people. Jobs that need emotional intelligence, such as nursing and counselling, will also stay. A robot can measure your temperature, but it cannot really understand how you feel.

Robots will also create new jobs. In the future, the world will need more robot engineers and researchers. Jennifer, a young engineer, says, “Robots are tools. They help us, but people decide what to do with them.” To get ready for the future, students should learn to think, to work with others and to keep learning new things.
vocab: robot 机器人 · replace 取代 · creativity 创造力 · emotional intelligence 情商 · depend on 取决于 · engineer 工程师 · task 任务
